# TokenReplaceScope

`schemas/api/scope/token-replace.json`

The scope of token.replace (docs/design/m0/04 "Token administration", 14 M4): the live token to rotate. One command revokes it and issues its holder a new token, so the holder keeps its actor and grants; the old bearer is rejected and its streams close. The new secret reaches only the live response of the call that applied it (14 N3); a retry under the same idempotency key replays without it. Only an operator replaces in this build.
